disambiguation: It is a scripting environment for automation and API interaction, not a general-purpose command line interpreter.
extras: This is a third-party plugin and is highly influenced by Emacs.
intentEvidence: Plugin REPL is easier to use in my opinion since you can just run code and use the command interface.
problem: Developers and users need a lightweight way to test JavaScript code and automate tasks within Obsidian without building or reloading a full plugin.

relations.evidence: If you have installed the dataview plugin, Plugin REPL gives you access to a dataview object dv

This plugin was based on the Obsidian sample plugin from Obsidian.

summary: Provides an Emacs-like Read-Eval-Print Loop (REPL) allowing users to execute JavaScript directly within Obsidian notes to automate tasks and interact with the plugin API.
